method.identity: Names matched to College Scorecard (Most-Recent-Cohorts-Institution); accreditor field used for the regional-accreditation screen. Unmatched names are listed, not guessed.
method.sophiaDepth: Each Sophia partner page parsed with the repo importer: transferRows = rows with a receiving course text; namedCourseRows = rows naming a single receiving course code.
method.demand: College Scorecard Field-of-Study award counts (mean of the two most recent years) by OPEID6.
method.score: 35*credits + 25*evidence + 20*demand + 10*cost + 10*gap; non-regionally-accredited x0.35. Credits use the explicit published transfer cap where captured; evidence ranks school-published tables over provider-published pages over policy-only.
method.rules: Facts carry the exact quote and the page fetched on 2026-11-26. A provider-published match is not acceptance. Units kept as published. No value is inferred; ambiguities are recorded.
